name: Mordecai
description: A 23-year-old blue jay. More conscientious and responsible than Rigby. Tends to be mild-mannered but can get serious when needed.
clothing: Natural feathers, sometimes a t-shirt or fanny pack.
emotion: Relaxed, but easily flustered or annoyed by Rigby.
accessories: Video game controller or a can of soda.
voice: Speaks calmly, often starting sentences with 'Dude...' or 'Whoa'.

name: Rigby
description: A 23-year-old raccoon. Impulsive, immature, and always looking for a shortcut. Often the cause of surreal problems.
emotion: Excitable, prone to fits of rage, and easily bored.
accessories: Loves video games, often seen with pizza.
voice: Speaks in a high-pitched, fast-paced voice. Often yells 'STOP TALKING!' or 'YEAH-YUH!'

name: Margaret
description: A red-breasted robin who works as a waitress. Kind, responsible, and down-to-earth.
clothing: Waitress uniform (pink dress) or casual wear.
accessories: Order pad and pen at work.
voice: Speaks in a sweet, friendly tone.

name: Eileen
description: A shy and intelligent mole who works at the coffee shop. Has a crush on Rigby.
clothing: A striped t-shirt and a skirt, often with glasses.
emotion: Timid and soft-spoken, but loyal and brave.
accessories: Her glasses, a book, or a laptop.
voice: Speaks in a quiet, slightly nerdy voice.

name: Benson
description: The park manager, a living gumball machine. He is easily angered by Mordecai and Rigby's laziness and is known for his short temper.
emotion: Constantly stressed, angry, or on the verge of yelling.
voice: Shouts frequently, often yelling 'YOU'RE FIRED!' or 'GET BACK TO WORK!'

name: Skips
description: A yeti who is the park's groundskeeper. He is immortal and incredibly wise, often solving the group's supernatural problems. He skips instead of walking.
voice: Speaks in a deep, gravelly voice. Usually says 'I've seen this before' and offers a cryptic solution.

name: Pops
description: A cheerful, naive, lollipop-shaped man who is the son of the park's owner. He is very wealthy but acts like a child.
clothing: A suit and a top hat.
voice: Speaks in a high-pitched, old-timey British accent. Often says 'Good show!' or 'Jolly good show!'

name: Muscle Man
description: A green, obese man who is another groundskeeper at the park. He is obnoxious and loves making 'My mom!' jokes.
emotion: Arrogant, loud, and prone to fits of rage.
voice: Speaks in a loud, grating voice. Frequently yells 'You know who else... MY MOM!'

name: High Five Ghost
description: A ghost with a hand extending from the top of his head. He is Muscle Man's best friend and is usually seen with him.
emotion: Calm and collected, often acting as the straight man to Muscle Man.
voice: Speaks in a quiet, ethereal voice.
